priorityList: Summon your pet before combat starts.
Sync offensive Racials (Berserking, Blood Fury, Ancestral Call, Fireblood) and Potions with Bestial Wrath.
Use on-use Trinkets when Bestial Wrath is ready or active.
Cast Barbed Shot if Bestial Wrath has less than one GCD remaining on its cooldown to maximize resets.
Cast Wild Thrash on cooldown to trigger Beast Cleave and maximize AoE damage.
Use Kill Command as your primary damage dealer and generator.
Cast Cobra Shot if the Hogstrider buff is active, Wild Thrash is on cooldown, and there are fewer than 4 targets.
Cast Barbed Shot to maintain Frenzy stacks and reduce the cooldown of Bestial Wrath, prioritizing targets with the lowest DoT duration.
Use Cobra Shot as a filler during Beast Cleave whenever Wild Thrash is on cooldown.
